text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service 'inference-prod' (high 5xx rate). Page targets: ops rotation, eng-sre, eng-runtime. Incident id: PD-18330022.
PagerDuty: Automatic page delivered to 6 users (2 acknowledged).
alex: acked. seeing lots of 502/503s from the inference edge. metrics -> 5xx spike at 18:23 UTC.
sara: i keep getting paged but i'm not on the current ops rotation? i was removed last week. :confused:
tim: same — i'm on backup but pd shows both @ops-oncall and @sara as targets. looks like two PD services are bound to the same integration key. i pulled the integration list.
ops-oncall: ```json
{"integration_key":"abcd-1234","services":["inference-prod","inference-prod-legacy"]}
```
ops-oncall: That explains duplicate deliveries — PD routed to both services which have overlapping schedules.
maria: can we mute one of the PD services while we fix routing? we should avoid muting the real on-call.
alex: agreed. I'm going to pause the legacy service escalation. will use PD API to set maintenance on inference-prod-legacy for 30m.
PagerDuty: Maintenance mode enabled for service 'inference-prod-legacy' by alex. Pages suppressed for that service.
sara: i still have an unacked page in my mobile. can someone confirm it will stop?
tim: mobile page should stop once PD suppression propagates; give it 30s. also i'm creating a temporary override to remove @sara from the inference-prod rule.
ops-oncall: temporary override created. removed schedule binding for 'users.sara' from inference-prod routing.
maria: quick customer-impact note: customer-facing request errors rose from 0.4% to 6.2% in the spike window (18:20-18:28 UTC). estimated affected qps ~120 (mostly long-sequence text-gen).
alex: root cause timeline: earlier deploy rolled out a new autoscaler config and a healthcheck tweak; a rollback failed to update PD service mapping which left a legacy service active. that legacy service had an always-on escalation to some folks who are no longer on rotation. when the error spike hit, PD duplicated pages.
sara: thanks — please remove me from any legacy bindings. this was noisy during dinner. :sleeping:
tim: short-term mitigation steps: 1) maintenance=on for legacy service (done). 2) revoke duplicate integration key on PD for legacy service (in progress). 3) rollback autoscaler change to previous stable (alex on it). 4) update runbook to verify PD service mappings as part of rollback checklist.
maria: doing initial customer comms: posting status page entry: "Partial degradation for text generation; retries in place. Engineers investigating."
alex: rollback started at 18:26 UTC. monitoring rollback now.
PagerDuty: Service 'inference-prod' shows 1 active incident, 3 acknowledgements (alex, tim, ops-oncall).
ops-oncall: after rollback and PD maintenance, pages have stopped. error rate trending down to baseline over last 3 minutes.
sara: confirmed no more pages on my phone. thanks.
alex: action items captured: (1) rotate PD integration keys and remove duplicate bindings, owner tim, due today EOD; (2) add PD binding verification to release rollback checklist, owner alex, due next deploy; (3) postmortem with timeline and customer impact, owner maria, draft by EOD tomorrow.
maria: provisional severity: Sev2 given customer-visible errors and multiple pages. will confirm after postmortem.
ops-oncall: leaving note — if anyone sees recurring duplicate pages in next 24h, add tag "pd-duplicate-binding" to incidents channel thread.
alex: thanks everyone, closing thread for now. will reopen if the PD dupes reappear. :thumbsup:
